_template_notes.purpose: Backend CQRS Pipeline graph — Discovery Plugin #13 (v2.0 Gói C++ Stage 2.2). Parse MediatR patterns: IRequest<TResponse>, IRequestHandler<TRequest, TResponse>, AbstractValidator<TRequest>, IPipelineBehavior<TRequest, TResponse>, INotification, INotificationHandler. Source: Grep MediatR base type matching. Consumed by lane CD18 (CQRS Pipeline Integrity) — phát hiện Request không có Handler, Handler không có Validator, missing pipeline behaviors (TransactionBehavior/LoggingBehavior/AuthorizationBehavior).
populate: nodes[]: 1 entry per CQRS type declaration — {id, name, kind, module, file_path, line, request_type?, response_type?, validates_for?, behavior_order?, fingerprint}
id format: '{module_short}.{type_name}' vd 'CRM.CreateCustomerCommand'
kind enum: 'command', 'query', 'request_handler', 'validator', 'pipeline_behavior', 'notification', 'notification_handler'
- command: : IRequest<TResponse> hoặc : IRequest VÀ name *Command
- query: : IRequest<TResponse> VÀ name *Query
- request_handler: : IRequestHandler<TReq, TResp> hoặc : IRequestHandler<TReq>
- validator: : AbstractValidator<TReq> (FluentValidation)
- pipeline_behavior: : IPipelineBehavior<TReq, TResp>
- notification: : INotification (MediatR pub/sub)
- notification_handler: : INotificationHandler<TNotif>
request_type: cho handler/validator, extract từ generic argument
response_type: cho command/query/handler, extract từ generic argument thứ 2
validates_for: cho validator, tên Request được validate (= request_type)
edges[]: pipeline relationships — {from, to, kind: 'handles|validates|wraps|notifies'}
handles: handler → request (request_handler.id → request.id qua request_type matching)
validates: validator → request (validator.id → request.id qua validates_for matching)
wraps: pipeline_behavior → request (qua wildcard hoặc specific request match)
notifies: notification_handler → notification
metadata.build_at: ISO 8601 timestamp khi graph built
metadata.scope_root: 'apps/backend' (v2.0)
metadata.source_method: 'grep_fallback|serena_find_symbol' (Serena primary nếu available)
metadata.parser_version: '1.0' (Grep + line-based). v2.1 → Roslyn syntax tree analyzer cho full generic resolution + namespace-qualified type names.
metadata.kinds_distribution: count per kind cho quick overview
metadata.modules_covered: list of module short names có CQRS types
metadata.cs_file_count: total .cs files scanned
metadata.coverage_indicators: {requests_without_handler, requests_without_validator, handlers_without_request} cho lane CD18 early warning
skip_conditions: Project KHÔNG có apps/backend/ → SKIP, write empty graph với skipped:true (lane CD18 sẽ fallback Grep với E135 WARN)
Tech stack backend != .NET → SKIP, log E137 WARN (parser chỉ support C# MediatR conventions)
Không tìm thấy MediatR pattern nào (0 request + 0 handler) → write nodes=[] với skipped:false + WARN E139 (project có thể dùng custom mediator hoặc minimal API only)
